stories.title: Orchestrate Clinical Trials and Provider Detail Flows
stories.description: Implement core orchestration logic in evaluate_care_facade to coordinate calls between clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, including sequencing, parameter passing, and aggregation of results into a unified response.

stories.title: Integrate Facade with Tool Router
stories.description: Register evaluate_care_facade methods with the tool_router to enable governed invocation via LLM tool-use, ensuring allowlist enforcement and Pydantic validation alignment.

stories.title: Add Unit Tests for EvaluateCare Facade
stories.description: Create unit tests validating facade orchestration behavior, including successful aggregation, error handling paths, and schema compliance for both clinical trials and provider detail flows.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test via Chat Flow
stories.description: Validate full integration of evaluate_care_facade through the chat-driven tool-use loop in main.py, ensuring correct invocation, response propagation, and compatibility with conversational UX flows.
